notes.title: Future update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I've been working hard on the game lately. The next update will take the game in a whole new direction—one that feels much more polished. I can't wait for you to experience it!

A lot of work has been done on the UI, thanks to a talented artist.

notes.title: Release date : Defying the shadows
notes.notes:
What's new ?
I am finalizing the adjustment of the general balance of the game, heroes as well as monsters. I am also fixing the last bugs that I encounter to ensure a good experience.

Be prepared to discover and conquer the shadow army, it's already in 10 days!
